explication: JeecgBoot is an enterprise AI low-code platform: users configure or describe business needs, create online forms and data models, generate or run applications, and use AI applications and knowledge-base Q&A. The repository also documents workflow, reporting, permissions, and enterprise administration capabilities. The sampled chat and knowledge controllers show service delegation and embedding-related behavior; broader product branches are retained from the README and tree, but their internal calls are not inferred where source was not sampled.
